Headline options:
- Duplicate checklists in your project
- Limited beta: checklist duplication for Standard plan owners

Confirmed change: Project owners can duplicate an existing checklist within the same project.

Scoped audience impact: Available in limited beta to selected workspaces for project owners on the Standard plan.

Limitation: File attachments are not copied, and cross-project duplication is unavailable.

Migration note: None required; no action is needed.

CTA: “Read the beta notes.”

Unresolved items: Beta availability beyond selected workspaces, broader release timing, and any additional behavior are unspecified.

Fact trace: CN1 supports the confirmed change; E1 supports CN1 and both limitations.

Actions outside announcement framing: None required.
